scenario_description:
Objective: Enrich a confirmed Railyard natural-dye talk with a free, labeled wool swatch packet useful for Maren's own textile notes.
Emerging Need: An early event preview only hints at possible attendee extras; later companionship, ticketing, and a same-day reply window make one packet concrete.
Decision Context: Stored textile-care records determine which dye-family packet would be meaningful, while observed records supply the event commitment, order number, reply address, and cutoff.
Consequence: Timely use of the limited option can add a small conservation reference without changing the outing; after the pickup list closes, the talk simply proceeds without it.

parameter.subject: September natural-dye talk preview
parameter.body: Our Friday, September 4 evening talk, 'Plants, Minerals, and Blues,' is on the calendar from 6:30 to 7:45 p.m. at the Railyard Dye Lab classroom. Staff are considering a few no-cost attendee extras, but signups and ticket-holder instructions are not open yet.

parameter.content: That dye talk you forwarded looks like an easy Friday outing. I can meet outside SITE at 6:10 if you end up going; no need to plan dinner around me.

parameter.subject: Ticket-holder swatch packets for Plants, Minerals, and Blues
parameter.body: For September 4 ticket holders, we can set aside one free labeled wool swatch packet per order while the small batch lasts. Available dye-family packets are cochineal, weld, indigo, or walnut. Reply to swatchdesk@railyarddyelab.example by 3:00 p.m. today with your order reference and one dye family; pickup names are printed after that deadline.

parameter.subject: Swatch packet list is now closed
parameter.body: The complimentary swatch packet list for Plants, Minerals, and Blues has closed and all pickup names have been printed. Ticket check-in is unchanged, and the talk will still open at 6:15 p.m. on September 4.
